name: KinFlo Convex live smoke manifest

providerBoundary.notes: This manifest defines the approved hosted smoke order only. It does not execute Convex functions, import generated API files, create provider resources, or write production data.

blockedUntil: Hosted Convex deployment exists and is owned by Vambah.
CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT and VITE_CONVEX_URL are configured outside committed source.
Convex auth issuer and client id are configured outside committed source.
npm run kinflo:activation-preflight, npm run kinflo:validate-generated-api, npm run kinflo:validate-live-smoke, and npm run kinflo:live-handoff pass immediately before codegen.
npm run convex:codegen runs after hosted setup approval and generated API bindings are reviewed.
Rollback owner is named and fixture adapter fallback is confirmed.

evidence: secret env files are untracked
convex/_generated files are untracked before approved codegen
generated API remains unimported until hosted setup approval
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: No audit event expected because no hosted mutation runs.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep fixture adapters selected and do not run hosted Convex commands.

evidence: signed-in user is synced
platform admin bootstrap is idempotent
viewer returns expected membership and platform role
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Bootstrap mutation writes an identity/admin audit event or confirms the existing idempotent admin record.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep admin shell on fixtures, pause new invitations, and preserve bootstrap audit output.

evidence: readiness counts tenants, sites, users, roles, billing plans, and published pages
smoke seed creates tenant, site, page, resolver args, entitlements, and audit event
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: activation.seedSmokeSite records activation_smoke_seeded with tenant and site ids.
smokeSteps.rollback: Delete only approved smoke records or leave them marked as smoke data; do not import production records.

evidence: default role catalog is synced
viewer permission snapshot is tenant and site scoped
allow and deny checks match expected role capabilities
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep permission guards on fixture/REST fallback and do not invite client admins until deny checks pass.

evidence: super admin sees only expected tenants
tenant-scoped site query excludes other tenants
audit event list is permission guarded
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Read-only step captures prior audit events from identity, activation, and role sync.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep shell tenant tables on fixture data until read-only scope checks pass.

evidence: default plan catalog is available
effective entitlement snapshot resolves plan and overrides
usage snapshot reports current, limit, remaining, and allowed values
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Read-only step captures entitlement snapshots after activation seed.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep entitlement UI on fixture data and block live site creation if limits are inconsistent.

evidence: starter templates include quality contract metadata
draft client site is created from template
client admin invitation is scoped to tenant and site
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: siteFactory.createSiteFromTemplate and controlPlane.createInvitation write site creation and invitation audit events.
smokeSteps.rollback: Archive smoke site or keep it unpublished, revoke invite, and keep launch packets fixture-backed.

evidence: published verified site resolves
draft page stays hidden
resolver returns public-safe site, page, navigation, content, and lead capture data
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Read-only public resolver smoke references prior publish or activation audit evidence.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep public preview route on fixtures and do not map domains to live resolver.

evidence: public lead submission creates a site-scoped lead
tenant admin can list only authorized leads
lead timeline includes submission event
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: crm.submitLead writes a lead event and tenant/site scoped timeline evidence.
smokeSteps.rollback: Keep public forms on preview fallback, mark smoke lead as test data, and pause outbound integrations.

evidence: custom domain entitlement limit is enforced
duplicate hostname is rejected
domain metadata updates without creating DNS or SSL provider records
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: siteBuilder.upsertDomain writes custom domain audit evidence without DNS provider writes.
smokeSteps.rollback: Remove or deactivate smoke domain metadata and keep DNS/Vercel domain steps blocked.

evidence: draft query returns pages, nav, blocks, visibility, assets, and domains
content edits are site-permission guarded
publish mutation creates a public-safe published page
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: siteBuilder.publishPage and content mutations write publish/content audit evidence.
smokeSteps.rollback: Unpublish smoke page, leave audit trail intact, and keep public resolver off live site until review passes.

evidence: tenant and site mutations enforce platform and tenant permissions
theme and status changes write audit evidence
membership and invitation lifecycle is reversible in smoke data
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Every tenant control-plane mutation writes or references a scoped audit event.
smokeSteps.rollback: Archive smoke tenant/site records, revoke pending invites, and keep client onboarding blocked until cleanup is verified.

evidence: pipeline stage is lead:manage guarded
lead update and assignment append timeline events
task creation is scoped to authorized tenant/site lead data
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: CRM workflow mutations append lead event timeline evidence.
smokeSteps.rollback: Delete or mark smoke pipeline/task data as test-only and keep outbound notification integrations paused.

evidence: default billing plans sync without Stripe writes
manual entitlement override is billing:manage guarded
override appears in entitlement snapshot
smokeSteps.auditEvidence: Billing plan sync and entitlement override write billing audit evidence without Stripe provider writes.
smokeSteps.rollback: Remove smoke override, keep Stripe Billing gated, and restore fixture entitlement display if snapshot diverges.
